answer: Require every agent to wander: each identity must periodically migrate between task nebulas, posting a small umber bond at every move, refunded only after verified work in the new cluster. A real agent wanders once and earns its bond back; a sybil operator cloning a hundred identities must post a hundred bonds and complete a hundred real jobs to recover them, so the cost of faking scale rises linearly while the payoff stays flat. A nebula that sees the same identity arrive twice without intervening work keeps the bond.
